subject: gk
question: As of November 2022, in which of the following periods in Indian history was the Republic Day parade NOT performed at the Rajpath(now called Kartavya Path)?
solution: The correct answer is __**1950-1954**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • Initially, the Republic Day parade was not held at Rajpath (now called Kartavya Path). • From 1950 to 1954, the venue for the parade was not fixed and it was held at different locations within Delhi. • The parade was first held at Rajpath (then Kingsway) in 1955. • Since 1955, Rajpath has been the permanent venue for the annual Republic Day parade.
